clue.text: Speak of grief, though it should be written off

parts.note: to utter is to speak or voice something
loss is bereavement, a cause of grief

explanation.surface: A mourner is told to voice their sorrow even though it ought to be put behind them.
explanation.definitionFit: Something written off in accounting is a total write-off with nothing recovered.

clue.text: English river on course

definitions.meaning: the ... flows through north-east England to the sea at Middlesbrough
a golf course has small pegs to set the ball on, and also teeing grounds

explanation.definitionFit: A northern English waterway shares its name with the golfer's pegs and teeing grounds found around a links.

clue.text: Work entering entry is a measure of disorder

indicators.note: one piece going into another is the container signal, so the work word sits inside the second word

parts.note: taken as written
OP is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: A piece of work being let into a doorway somehow measures chaos.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entering' puts OP inside ENTRY, between ENTR and Y.
explanation.definitionFit: In physics and information theory this quantity gauges the randomness or disorder of a system.

clue.text: Go ahead with removing the old church roofing

definitions.meaning: to begin or start proceedings, take the first step
old church roofs were made of lead sheet

explanation.definitionFit: To open the batting or begin is to start first; stripping the metal from a church roof literally takes that metal away.

clue.text: In this way footballers get a seat for two or three

parts.note: so means thus, in this manner
FA is the Football Association, the body of English footballers

explanation.surface: Football players manage to grab somewhere to sit for a small group.
explanation.walkthrough: The FA is the governing body of English football.
explanation.definitionFit: A couch or settee seats a few people side by side.

clue.text: A long stretch not found in light literature

definitions.meaning: a stretch is a prison term, so a long one is a lengthy jail term
easy reading has no ponderous, weighty sentences

explanation.definitionFit: A judge handing down many years in prison gives a severe term, and a ponderous line of prose is also weighty writing.

clue.text: Knock somebody's plaster bird off the wall, but first run

definitions.text: Knock somebody's plaster bird off the wall
definitions.meaning: the literal reading: smashing a china or plaster duck from a wall display
in cricket a batter on nought (a duck) gets off the mark by scoring a first run

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a duck is a score of nought; flying plaster ducks were a classic British wall ornament.
explanation.definitionFit: A cricketer who gets off zero has scored at last, while the literal sense smashes an ornamental wall decoration.

clue.text: Abscond with army tucker in the Gulf

parts.note: to desert is to run away from duty
tucker is Australian slang for food, i.e. fare, and army food read as war fare

explanation.surface: A soldier runs off taking the troops' rations during a Middle East campaign.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tucker' is Australian slang for food; WAR + FARE is food for an army at war, read whole as fighting.
explanation.definitionFit: Fighting in the sands of the Gulf War was combat in arid terrain.

clue.text: Wild flowers or proper cultivated blooms?

parts.note: prim means prudish and proper
roses are flowers grown in gardens

explanation.surface: A gardener wonders whether to grow hedgerow blossoms or formal garden ones.
explanation.definitionFit: These pale yellow spring blooms grow wild in British woods and hedgerows.

clue.text: One who lubricates round army vehicle liable to cause pollution

indicators.note: the lubricator word is placed round the vehicle word so the vehicle sits inside it

parts.note: an oiler is someone who oils machinery
a tank is an armoured military vehicle

explanation.surface: A mechanic oiling a military vehicle risks spilling and contaminating the area.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' puts OILER round TANK: OIL + TANK + ER. The definition describes the ship rather than naming it.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship carrying crude can spill and foul the sea, so it is a likely source of slicks.

clue.text: Parson Small I pumps the accelerator

parts.note: Rev is short for Reverend, title of a parson
S is the abbreviation for small, as in clothing sizes

explanation.surface: A clergyman confesses to stamping on the car's pedal.
explanation.definitionFit: Pressing the gas pedal makes an engine race and spin faster.

clue.text: Stop in Panama

definitions.meaning: a punctuation mark, two dots, a pause in writing
Colón is a port city at the Caribbean end of the Panama Canal

explanation.definitionFit: A punctuation mark halts a sentence, and a Panamanian port city bears the same name.

clue.text: Setback for research establishment, one in Indonesia

indicators.note: a setback turns the laboratory word back to front

parts.note: a lab is a laboratory, where research is done
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A research institute in South-East Asia suffers a reverse.
explanation.definitionFit: This island is a province of the Indonesian archipelago.

clue.text: Don't refuse permission to board-admit

definitions.meaning: to allow a passenger aboard a bus or train
to reveal or confess a secret

explanation.definitionFit: Allowing someone aboard and revealing a secret are both senses of the phrasal verb.

clue.text: Stir-the coins in one's pocket?

definitions.meaning: stir is slang for prison
loose change jingles, making a metallic sound

explanation.definitionFit: Slang for jail is also the jingling sound coins make.

clue.text: Teacher with a fork needs complete control

parts.note: a schoolmaster is a teacher
the letter Y is shaped like a fork

explanation.surface: A teacher armed with a fork must keep total order.
explanation.walkthrough: Y stands for a fork because of the letter's shape.
explanation.definitionFit: Total command or expertise over something is dominance.

clue.text: What to do about your form if you put on weight

definitions.text: What to do about your form
definitions.meaning: complete an application form by writing in the details
gaining weight makes one plumper

explanation.definitionFit: Completing paperwork and growing plumper are both meanings of the phrasal verb.

clue.text: Have an aim which is self-defeating

parts.note: to own is to have or possess
a goal is an aim or target

explanation.surface: Someone sets themselves a target that only works against them.
explanation.definitionFit: Scoring into your own net in football is the classic image of an act that harms yourself.

clue.text: The rest of the church's Bible

definitions.text: The rest of the church's Bible

parts.words: The rest of the church's Bible
parts.note: rest is read as a support or stand on which the church Bible rests, not as the remainder

explanation.definitionFit: A reading desk in church holds the large Bible from which lessons are read.

clue.text: Worry expressed one hundred and one times by the navy

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
once means one time
RN is the Royal Navy

explanation.surface: The navy voices anxiety a hundred and one times over.
explanation.definitionFit: Anxiety or unease about something is apprehension.

clue.text: Own up to swindle over an iron ship

parts.note: a con is a swindle
Fe is the chemical symbol for iron
SS is steamship

explanation.surface: Someone admits cheating someone over an ironclad vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: To admit or acknowledge a misdeed is to come clean about it.

clue.text: Father of Peleg brewed beer

indicators.note: brewing works the letters up into something new, so the drink word is rearranged

explanation.surface: A Biblical patriarch made a batch of ale.
explanation.walkthrough: In Genesis, Eber is the father of Peleg.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Genesis genealogy this patriarch begat Peleg, a descendant of Shem.

clue.text: What the sleuth picked up by sniffing around

definitions.text: What the sleuth picked up by sniffing around

parts.words: What the sleuth picked up by sniffing around
parts.note: a detective following a trail, read literally as a bloodhound nosing out a smell

explanation.definitionFit: A trail or odour followed by a detective or hound is the track it picks up.

clue.text: Adds pronouncedly to a woodman's kit it does

definitions.text: Adds pronouncedly to a woodman's kit it does

indicators.note: said out loud, the clue's first word sounds like a woodworking tool

parts.note: adds is the word heard

explanation.surface: A tool makes a welcome addition to a forester's equipment.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines and builds: the tool sounds like 'adds' and is an addition to a woodman's kit.
explanation.definitionFit: An axe-like tool with an arched blade is used for shaping timber, part of a woodworker's equipment.

clue.text: Account given to the beak

definitions.meaning: an invoice or statement of charges
a bird's beak

explanation.definitionFit: An invoice and a bird's mouthpart share the word.

clue.text: Keen about 6 AD

indicators.note: the year abbreviation goes about the number, enclosing it

parts.note: taken as written
VI is six in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Someone is eager to talk about the year 6 AD.
explanation.definitionFit: Being eager or enthusiastic is being keen.

clue.text: Charismatic church meeting seen by wartime troops

definitions.meaning: a lively, participatory act of worship
soldiers deployed in war are on duty at the front

explanation.definitionFit: A lively act of worship and military duty in war share the phrase.

clue.text: Parallel to neither a top, bottom, nor end

definitions.meaning: next to and running beside

definitions.text: neither a top, bottom, nor end
definitions.meaning: of a rectangle's edges, the remaining one is a lengthy flank

explanation.definitionFit: Running beside something is lying next to it, and a rectangle's lengthy flank is neither its top, bottom nor end.
